exposure: Participation in the Safety Ambassadors Program (SAP)
Peer-based injury prevention education delivered by high school students
cohort: The study included 8832 first and second-grade elementary school students (ages 6-8 years old) from 37 elementary schools who participated in the Safety Ambassadors Program.
finding: The Safety Ambassadors Program significantly improved both safety knowledge and behavior modification among first and second-grade elementary school students.
